sections.heading: Quick Start
sections.body: Install the app for your role, create and verify your account, add children or buses (or join with a school code), then enable notifications and location services.

sections.heading: Everyday tips
sections.body: Use the embedded tutorials to refresh tracking, alerts, and dashboard workflows so every trip stays on schedule.

sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
sections.body: Pick the appropriate app tab to see the most common questions and step-by-step answers.
